findings.message: Only 10 defect parts (at least 30 asked for) and 10 good parts (at least 30 asked for) were measured. Rates on so few parts mislead: one defect part is 10.00 percent of the defect parts and one good part is 10.00 percent of the good parts, so one part moves a rate by that much, and no escape among a handful of defect parts does not show that the escape rate is low. Measure more parts before accepting the station on these numbers.
findings.fix: Measure more parts before accepting a station on these numbers, or lower the minimum if the sample is small on purpose and say so.
